def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg:
            line=i; color=r[0]
            ys=[y for y in range(h) if y!=i and any(v not in (bg,color) for v in g[y])]
            toward=1 if max(ys)<i else -1
            cells=[(y,x,g[y][x]) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if g[y][x] not in (bg,color)]
            ng=[r[:] for r in g]
            for y,x,v in cells: ng[y][x]=bg
            for y,x,v in cells:
                yy=y+toward
                if 0<=yy<h and yy!=i: ng[yy][x]=v
            edge=(min(y for y,x,v in cells) if toward>0 else max(y for y,x,v in cells))+toward
            if 0<=edge<h: ng[edge]=[8]*w
            return ng
    return g
